services.name: Journey Optimizer access and sandbox setup
services.scope: Configure Journey Optimizer roles and sandboxes. Map the licensed channels to the first use cases and record the channel settings the implementation needs.
services.adobe_quote: Define all the technical parameters required for email, mobile messages, push notifications, web push, direct mail, and other channels

services.name: Journey Optimizer email channel configuration
services.scope: For a licensed email channel, delegate the sending subdomain and configure the IP pool, email headers, execution fields and consent settings. Test the email channel using an approved profile.
services.adobe_quote: Configure the technical parameters (subdomain, IP pool, headers) in each email channel configuration

source.title: Experience League: Journey Optimizer email configuration

services.name: First scheduled campaigns in Journey Optimizer
services.scope: Build and test the agreed scheduled campaigns using existing Experience Platform audiences and the licensed channels. Configure campaign settings and schedule and validate the first test send or delivery.
services.adobe_quote: Audiences must be available in Adobe Experience Platform before creating campaigns.

source.title: Experience League: Get started with Journey Optimizer campaigns

services.name: Audience entry and profile events in Journey Optimizer Starter
services.scope: Configure the agreed audience entry or supported profile-level entry for the first journeys. Test data and actions with sample profiles. Business-event setup is excluded for this package.
services.adobe_quote: Start with a Read Audience: you can set your journey to listen to Adobe Experience Platform audiences.

source.title: Experience League: Journey Optimizer audiences in journeys

services.name: AEM Assets users and access setup
services.scope: Set up user groups and attach product profiles for the agreed AEM Assets environment. Validate author, administrator and restricted user access.
services.adobe_quote: Adds users to the Adobe Admin Console organization, creates user groups, and attaches product profiles to groups.

source.title: Experience League: AEM user groups and product profiles

services.name: Standard AEM Assets renditions
services.scope: Configure standard processing profiles for the agreed asset folders and check that sample uploads generate the expected renditions.
services.adobe_quote: Several asset processing profiles can be configured on the folder, into which assets are uploaded, to add specific metadata, renditions

source.title: Experience League: AEM Assets processing profiles

services.name: AEM 6.5 maintenance and service packs
services.scope: Review the service packs that apply to the deployment. Validate applicable updates in a test environment, run the agreed checks, coordinate production installation and review logs and rollback readiness.
services.adobe_quote: Restart the instance before installation if the instance is in update mode

source.title: Experience League: AEM 6.5 service pack installation

services.name: Upgrade AEM 6.5 to AEM 6.5 LTS
services.scope: Assess the existing AEM 6.5 environment, extensions and runtime requirements. Rehearse the upgrade on a copy, update the agreed code and configuration, run acceptance tests and plan the production cutover and rollback.
services.adobe_quote: The upgrade to AEM 6.5 LTS is available for all supported 6.5 Service Packs.

source.title: Experience League: Upgrade to AEM 6.5 LTS

services.name: AEM 6.5 go-live validation
services.scope: Verify the agreed author and publish environments, test the critical publishing and page paths, confirm backups and rollback and agree the cutover sequence.

source.title: Experience League: AEM 6.5 LTS post-upgrade checks

services.name: Target users and audience setup
services.scope: Set up Adobe Target users and roles in Admin Console. Configure the agreed environments, reporting settings and initial audiences.
services.adobe_quote: Add users and manage their permissions in the Adobe Admin Console for a Target Standard account.

source.title: Experience League: Target Standard user permissions

services.name: Marketo Engage lead scoring and data hygiene
services.scope: Audit lead data, standardize agreed fields, set up lead scoring and test the handoff to sales with representative leads.

source.title: Experience League: Plan a new Marketo Engage implementation

services.name: Marketo Engage sandbox validation
services.scope: Configure an entitled sandbox for the agreed implementation tests. Scope test data and CRM connections, validate the programs and document the promotion steps.
services.adobe_quote: A Marketo Engage sandbox is an additional instance used for testing purposes before implementation in the production environment.

services.name: Workfront environment promotion setup
services.scope: Map the sandbox and target environment, package the agreed Workfront objects with their dependencies, and validate an installation rehearsal before moving changes to production.

source.title: Experience League: Workfront environment promotion packages

services.name: Workfront custom field localization
services.scope: Inventory the agreed custom field labels and tooltips, configure translated terms and verify the displayed language with users.
services.adobe_quote: Localization applies to custom field labels (including when used as a column header) and tooltips.

services.name: Workfront Data Connect reporting setup
services.scope: Set up the Workfront Data Connect reader account and a connection for the approved reporting tool. Configure the network allowlist and verify sample reporting queries.
services.adobe_quote: Then, you must add any required IPs to the allowlist

source.title: Experience League: Connect to Workfront Data Connect

services.name: Workfront Ultimate financial setup
services.scope: Configure approved job role and user cost rates, validate planned and actual cost calculations against sample Workfront projects, and agree who maintains the rates.
services.adobe_quote: To track costs, you must associate users and job roles with hourly cost rates.

source.title: Experience League: Track costs in Workfront
